name: ai-email-campaign-builder
description: AI Email Marketing Campaign Builder — college project (local only)

scripts.predev: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
